LESSON: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASS: PREPOSITIONS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 13
Topic 13.3: Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Which words show direction and time?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify prepositions of time, in, on, at; place in, on, at and direction into, towards, to, through in sentences
2. use prepositions of time, place and direction appropriately for effective communication
3. appreciate the accuracy, appropriateness and correctness of prepositions used in varied texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GRAMMAR IN USE 13.3.1 WORD CLASS: PREPOSITIONS
This lesson teaches Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions for Grade 5 ENGLISH LANGUAGE.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify prepositions of time, in, on, at; place in, on, at and direction into, towards, to, through in sentences
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. use prepositions of time, place and direction appropriately for effective communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the accuracy, appropriateness and correctness of prepositions used in varied texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions above.
2. Explain Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Grammar in Use 13.3.1 Word Class: Prepositions important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Which words show direction and time?
2. Why is it important to show time and direction?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify prepositions of time, in, on, at; place in, on, at and direction into, towards, to, through in sentences
2. use prepositions of time, place and direction appropriately for effective communication
3. appreciate the accuracy, appropriateness and correctness of prepositions used in varied texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
